plugins.name: prntcode-ceo
plugins.description: PRNTCODE CEO agent: a half-week refresh that posts Khaled's PRNTCODE time needs to the Coordinator ledger (run silently as a feeder by the Coordinator's Sun/Wed 20:00 collect, or by hand with a handoff to planning); the Monday Pack as its own Sunday feeder; 'what now' for focus blocks; close-task; meeting-tasks; the Monday Pack; Finance (a 12-month forecast, scenarios, PO checks, a monthly capital efficiency review and one silent daily run); Legal on Anthropic's legal plugin with PRNTCODE's playbook; and the first department skills: catalogue review (Operations), brand formatter (Marketing) and pricing (Sales).
